description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST repeats the DISCOVER's Option 55 (Parameter Request List) byte sequence verbatim (RFC 2131 §4.3.6 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Option 55 lists which configuration options the client wants the server to send back. RFC 2131 §4.3.6 requires REQUEST to repeat the same list as DISCOVER — otherwise the server might omit options the client still needs.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER with Option 55 = [byte sequence P] → harness snapshots P
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • Option 55 == P (verbatim)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST.Option55 byte sequence equals the snapshotted DISCOVER.Option55.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_request_param_request_mismatch — REQUEST.Option55 differs from DISCOVER.Option55

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_request_param_request_mismatch: DUT DHCPREQUEST Option 55 mismatch with DISCOVER
